purpose: Geometry-only reference for physical printed line right edges; this region was not selected as genre ground truth.

source.coordinate_space: Unmodified normalized source image, not the enlarged review crops.

region.crop_bbox_role: Enclosing rectangle of the region inspected in overlapping enlarged crops.
region.selection_reason: Top-of-column consecutive rows containing staggered right edges, short rows, and indented rows.

coordinate_conventions.origin: Top-left source pixel; x increases rightward and y downward.
coordinate_conventions.bounds: Approximate outer ink bounds: left/top inclusive, right/bottom exclusive. These are not exact pixel-mask boundaries.
coordinate_conventions.right_edge: Right boundary of the rightmost printed glyph or punctuation belonging to this physical row, including commas, periods, ellipses, quotation marks, or brackets. Ignore detached background specks and faint scan halos.
coordinate_conventions.physical_row: One visible horizontal printed row. Never concatenate a short or indented row with the preceding/following row to reconstruct a literary line.
coordinate_conventions.uncertainty_meaning: Each coordinate is a manual visual estimate with approximately plus/minus 3 px tolerance, not a calibrated confidence interval.
coordinate_conventions.text_hint: Non-authoritative visually read anchor only; not OCR output and not transcription ground truth.

review.method: Manual visual estimation by the model from the original image and PIL-generated enlarged coordinate-grid crops.
image_operations_used: draw manually entered bounds for visual checking
limitations: Model-reviewed visual annotations are not independent human-certified ground truth.
Blur and grayscale halos make exact foreground cutoffs ambiguous; all four bounds remain approximate.
Closing punctuation on physical row 12 is visually ambiguous in identity; its rightmost printed mark is included in the geometric endpoint.
These 18 rows cover only one local region of one page and are not representative of all pages, typography, or genres.
No claim is made about literary-line identity, poem structure, or genre.
